# Training

**External** Isaac Lab project (generated by `isaaclab.bat --new`; it lives outside the Isaac Lab repo
and uses it as an installed library) containing the reinforcement-learning task of the Manipolazione
project: a **FANUC M-710iD/50M with a two-claw gripper** that has to grasp a square bracket lying on
the floor.

Registered tasks (name to use with `--task`):

| Task | Use |
|---|---|
| `Move-To-Grasp-Apps-v0` | training |
| `Move-To-Grasp-Apps-Play-v0` | replaying a checkpoint and debugging |

How each module, gate and parameter behaves is explained in
[`workspace_notes/ARCHITETTURA_APPS_PREGRASP.md`](../../../../workspace_notes/ARCHITETTURA_APPS_PREGRASP.md);
the structure of this package in
[`workspace_notes/MANUALE_PACCHETTO_TRAINING_ISAACLAB.md`](../../../../workspace_notes/MANUALE_PACCHETTO_TRAINING_ISAACLAB.md).

## Structure

```
Training/
├── scripts/                      → programs to launch from a terminal
│   ├── list_envs.py              → lists the registered tasks
│   ├── zero_agent.py             → zero-action agent (environment sanity check)
│   ├── random_agent.py           → random-action agent
│   └── rsl_rl/
│       ├── train.py, play.py     → training / replay entry points with RSL-RL (PPO)
│       ├── train_rsl_rl.py, play_rsl_rl.py → logic used by the entry points
│       ├── play_gate_tmp.py      → replay that prints angle/perp/along for each claw
│       └── cli_args.py           → shared arguments
└── source/Training/              → Python package (installed with pip install -e)
    └── Training/
        ├── robots/apps.py        → APPS_CFG: articulation, gains, initial pre-grasp pose
        ├── props/staffa_quadrata.py → the bracket to grasp
        ├── ui_extension_example.py  → example UI extension (optional)
        └── tasks/manager_based/move_to_grasp/
            ├── move_to_grasp_env_cfg.py → scene, actions, rewards, terminations (robot-agnostic)
            ├── arm_descriptor.py, gripper_descriptor.py → schema of the robot-agnostic descriptors
            ├── config/apps/
            │   ├── move_to_grasp_apps_cfg.py → Apps-specific numbers: grasp frames, PhysX buffers
            │   └── agents/rsl_rl_ppo_cfg.py  → PPO: 24 steps per env, 1500 iterations
            └── mdp/
                ├── actions.py, actions_cfg.py → staged actions (IK and joints)
                ├── stages.py                  → stage machine ALIGN → SLIDE → DESCEND
                ├── claw_geometry.py           → gripper geometry shared by the MDP terms
                ├── observations.py, rewards.py, terminations.py, events.py
```

The task is written to be independent of the robot: everything specific to Apps lives in
`config/apps/` and `robots/apps.py`. Using another arm means writing a similar file, without
touching the task.

## Installation

Isaac Lab 3.0.0-beta2 must already be installed (see the README at the repository root). The package
is installed into the Python that has Isaac Lab, which here is the one in `C:\isaacsim`, so it goes
through `isaaclab.bat -p`:

```powershell
cd myProjects\Manipolazione\Apps\Training
isaaclab.bat -p -m pip install -e source\Training
```

The USD file paths (`robots/apps.py` → `Apps/Simulation/robotApps_local.usd`,
`props/staffa_quadrata.py` → `Apps/Props/staffa_quadrata.usd`) are absolute and point to
`C:\Projects\myProjects\Manipolazione\...`: the repository must be cloned into `C:\Projects`.

> ⚠️ The `.gitignore` in this folder contains `**/__*`, which excludes **every `__init__.py`**
> from git. These include the ones that register the tasks with `gym.register`: a clean clone of the
> repository does not contain them and the tasks are not registered. They have to be added by hand
> (`git add -f`) or the rule must be removed.

## Usage

From `Apps/Training/`:

```powershell
# environment sanity check, no policy
isaaclab.bat -p scripts\zero_agent.py   --task Move-To-Grasp-Apps-v0 --viz kit
isaaclab.bat -p scripts\random_agent.py --task Move-To-Grasp-Apps-v0 --viz kit

# training
isaaclab.bat -p scripts\rsl_rl\train.py --task Move-To-Grasp-Apps-v0 --headless

# replay a checkpoint
isaaclab.bat -p scripts\rsl_rl\play.py --task Move-To-Grasp-Apps-Play-v0 --num_envs 16 ^
    --load_run <run_folder> --checkpoint <model_N.pt>

# gate diagnostics: angle/perp/along for each claw
isaaclab.bat -p scripts\rsl_rl\play_gate_tmp.py --task Move-To-Grasp-Apps-Play-v0 --num_envs 16 ^
    --headless --load_run <run_folder> --checkpoint <model_N.pt>
```

Notes:

- Isaac Lab 3.0 starts **headless by default**: without `--viz kit` no window appears and the script
  looks hung.
- `list_envs.py` filters ids containing `Template-`, so it **does not show** the `Move-To-Grasp-*`
  tasks. To see them, change the filter at line 90 of the script.
- `train.py` and `play.py` emit a `DeprecationWarning` (Isaac Lab recommends
  `isaaclab train --rl_library rsl_rl`) but they work.
- Run logs go to `logs/` (experiment `move_to_grasp`) and can be read with TensorBoard.

## IDE (optional)

In VS Code, `Ctrl+Shift+P` → `Tasks: Run Task` → `setup_python_env`: it asks for the absolute path of
Isaac Sim and creates `.vscode/.python.env` with the extension paths, for autocompletion. If Pylance
does not index the package, add `<path>/source/Training` to `python.analysis.extraPaths` in
`.vscode/settings.json`.
